areas.greenway:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a PRODUCTION PIXEL ART SPRITE ATLAS for the Trail area of a mobile incremental guild game. Reference image is STYLE and material/scale guide only, NOT a UI to reproduce.
Canvas precisely 1536x1536, a strict invisible 3-column by 6-row grid, cell512x256; no visible grid borders. Transparent alpha gutters. Content must stay inside its cell. No words, digits, labels, UI, people, workers, monsters, baked currency or buttons. Chunky detailed polished pixel art matching reference: crisp pixel clusters, rich navy slate shadows, layered material texture, timber braces, warm gold lanterns, saturated aqua highlights. Straight-on side view. Not smooth vector/flat rectangles.
Theme: sunny alpine forest trail, blue mountains, green fir trees, timber bridges and expedition camps.
ROW 1: column1 bright outdoor sky/mountain/forest backdrop rectangle filling cell, no terrain; column2 repeating deep area stone/timber atmospheric background rectangle filling cell; column3 small isolated distinct resource props (ore, wood, tools, crates) on alpha.
ROWS2–6 correspond five stations. COLUMN1 in each row is a fully opaque complete environment background rectangle: Path with rocks, boot trail and a route sign; Porter Camp with tents, timber supply platform; Scout Post with lookout scaffold and map table; Supply Depot with warehouse shelves and wagons; Caravan Terminus with large dispatch gate and freight tracks. No machinery or people. Draw full-width floor at y210 within each256-high cell, beautiful textured hanging rock or timber platform beneath, warm lanterns, depth in rear structures. Leave center front stage clear for workers and machinery. First of these5 backgrounds includes outdoor daylight, subsequent deeper floors have darker textured setting. COLUMN2 rows2–6 is only isolated transparent machinery: trail marker and hiking supply rack; timber handcart loaded with crates; tall brass telescope and survey table; canvas covered supply wagon and crate elevator; wooden freight caravan with wheels respectively, centered in each cell, machinery max300px wide x190px high with bottom at y210. COLUMN3 rows2–6 isolated alpha upgrade additions: reinforced stepping stone crossing; extra supply panniers; aqua-glass signal lantern; wooden loading crane; second small freight wagon respectively, centered bottom y210, no floor or background.
Keep coherent shared left/right platform joining edges and consistent pixel scale across every cell. Separate scenery and machinery exactly so game can animate them independently. NO scene screenshots or UI. Actual transparency outside standalone machines and scenery rectangles.

workers:
Production transparent PIXEL ART animation sprite sheet for the worker characters in the reference game style. Reference is art style only. Strict invisible 4 columns x6 rows grid on a 1024x1536 canvas, cells256x256; all drawings stay within central170px of eachcell, same groundbaseline y240. Actual transparent alpha background, no checkerboard baked in, no text or labels, no scenery. Each worker wears distinct readable work clothing and a small face. Crisp chunky pixel clusters, bright readable silhouette, warm gold highlights and navy outlines, polished handcrafted detailed pixel art. Side-facing people matching the reference miner scale and character appeal.
Six rows: 1 miner yellowhardhat blue shirt brown trousers with pickaxe;2 porter strawhat cream shirt blue trousers carrying crate;3 scout greenhood tan coat with map and staff;4 artisan brownapron redshirt with hammer;5 scholar navycoat turquoise accents with parchment;6 sailor cream shirt bluecap with rope.
Four columns: idle with tool lowered; work poseA preparing appropriateaction; workposeB completingaction; celebrate with toolraised. Exactly one body percell, same bodyidentity andfeetanchor throughoutrow, no ghost limbs, no extrapeople. Bodyheight210px so eachwillbe exported at64x96. Distinct mechanically sensible motion. No extra items outsidecells.
